function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

Ordinal = {"st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th"}

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({

        })
        Wait.frames(function()

            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

function createSetupButtons()

    if self.memo ~= "0" and self.memo ~= "1" then  
        self.createButton({
            label="S", click_function="setup", function_owner=self,
            position={0, 0, 0.75}, rotation={0,0,180}, height=230, width=230,

            font_size=200, color={1,1,1}, font_color={0,0,0}
        })     
    end

            label="Spell", click_function="draw_spell", function_owner=self,

            font_size=200, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.5,0.5,0.5}
        })
    end

end

function setup()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["dZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        DeepTreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        dCard = card
    end

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["tZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        TreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        tCard = card
    end

    if TreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, tCount do
            if TreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = TreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes() 
            end
        end 
    elseif tCard then
        tCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        tCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})
    end

    if DeepTreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, dCount do
            if DeepTreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                Wait.time(function() obj = DeepTreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                    --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                end,1)
            end
        end 
    elseif dCard then
        dCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        dCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})        
    end

    self.memo = "0"
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButtons()        

end

function draw_spell()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["sZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        spellsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        sCard = card
    end

    if spellsDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if spellsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = spellsDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes() 
            end
        end

        sCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        sCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})

    createSetupButtons()

--Draw Treasure
function draw_Treasure()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["tZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        TreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        tCard = card
    end

    if TreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if TreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = TreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()                
            end
        end
    elseif tCard then
        tCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6))
        tCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))                 
    end

    self.clearButtons()
    self.memo = "0"

end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function onLoad()
    merc = self.getDescription()
    mCount = 2
    iCount = 3
    tCount = 5

    zAxis = 10.46 
    createSetupButtons()
end 

function createSetupButtons()
  if self.memo ~= "0" then     
        self.createButton({
            label="S", click_function="Smuggler", function_owner=self,
            position={0, 0, 0.75}, rotation={0,0,180}, height=230, width=230,
            font_size=200, color={1,1,1}, font_color={0,0,0}
        })
  end

end

function Smuggler()

    --mark setup card
    local setup1 = getObjectFromGUID("e6ef2e")
    if setup1 ~= nil then
        setup1.setGMNotes(setup1.getGMNotes().."w")
        setup1.call("createSetupButtons")            
    end
    local setup2 = getObjectFromGUID("35d443")
    if setup2 ~= nil then
        setup2.setGMNotes(setup2.getGMNotes().."w")
        setup2.call("createSetupButtons")
    end

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["tZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        TreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        tCard = card
    end

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        ItemsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        iCard = card
    end

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        MissionsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        mCard = card
    end

    if MissionsDeck then
        for i = 1, mCount do
            if MissionsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = MissionsDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes() 
                obj.setGMNotes(merc)
obj.addTag("Active")
            end
        end 
    elseif mCard then
        mCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        mCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})
        mCard.memo = self.getGMNotes()
        mCard.setGMNotes(merc)
    end

    if ItemsDeck then
        for i = 1, iCount do
            if ItemsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                Wait.time(function() obj = ItemsDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                    --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                end,1)
            end
        end 
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        iCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})        
    end

    if TreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, tCount do
            if TreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                Wait.time(function() obj = TreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = {xAxis, 2, zAxis}, rotation = {0, 180, 180}})
                    --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                end,2)
            end
        end
    elseif tCard then
        tCard.setPositionSmooth({xAxis, 2, zAxis})
        tCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180})                 
    end


   self.clearButtons()
   self.memo = "0"
 
end

    end

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

function refill_missions(params)    

    local _count = params[1]
    if not _count or _count <= 0 then
        --print("no refill.")
        return
    end

    --print(self.getPosition()[1])
    --print(self.getPosition()[3])

    local x = self.getPosition()[1]
    local y = self.getPosition()[3]

    local _merc = self.getGMNotes()
    --print("merc:".._merc)

    Mercs = Global.getTable("mercTokens")    
    local _merc = getObjectFromGUID(Mercs[self.getGMNotes()])    
    local _loc = "no location"
    if _merc then
       _loc = _merc.getGMNotes() 
    else
        return
        print("merchant location not found")
    end

    --Missions deck
    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")    
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local ideck, iCarsswd
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                ideck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                iCard = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

    --draw new card    
    if  ideck then
        for i = 1, _count do
            if ideck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                local obj = ideck.takeObject({ position = Vector(x, 2.5, y), rotation = Vector(0, 180, 180) })
                obj.memo = _loc
                obj.setDescription(_merc.getDescription())
            obj.addTag("Active")
            end   
        end
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(Vector(0, 180, 180))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(Vector(x, 2.5, y))        
        iCard.memo = _loc
        iCard.setDescription(_merc.getDescription())
    end 

    broadcastToAll(_merc.getDescription().." Missions replenished.",  Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))

end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)

    end

    end

function refill_missions(params)    

    local _count = params[1]
    if not _count or _count <= 0 then
        --print("no refill.")
        return
    end

    --print(self.getPosition()[1])
    --print(self.getPosition()[3])

    local x = self.getPosition()[1]
    local y = self.getPosition()[3]

    local _merc = self.getGMNotes()
    --print("merc:".._merc)

    Mercs = Global.getTable("mercTokens")    
    local _merc = getObjectFromGUID(Mercs[self.getGMNotes()])    
    local _loc = "no location"
    if _merc then
       _loc = _merc.getGMNotes() 
    else
        return
        print("merchant location not found")
    end

    --Missions deck
    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")    
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local ideck, iCarsswd
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                ideck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                iCard = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

    --draw new card    
    if  ideck then
        for i = 1, _count do
            if ideck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                local obj = ideck.takeObject({ position = Vector(x, 2.5, y), rotation = Vector(0, 180, 180) })
                obj.memo = _loc
                obj.setDescription(_merc.getDescription())
            obj.addTag("Active")
            end   
        end
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(Vector(0, 180, 180))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(Vector(x, 2.5, y))        
        iCard.memo = _loc
        iCard.setDescription(_merc.getDescription())
    end 

    broadcastToAll(_merc.getDescription().." Missions replenished.",  Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))

end

                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 2 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )               
            end                
        elseif obj.type == "Card" then
            obj.clearContextMenu()
            obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
              function () loot_card(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
            )        
        end
    end
end

Ordinal = {"st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th"}

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

--Draw Treasure
function draw_Treasure()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["tZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        TreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        tCard = card
    end

    if TreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if TreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = TreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()                
            end
        end
    elseif tCard then
        tCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6))
        tCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))                 
    end

    self.clearButtons()
    self.memo = "0"

end

function onLoad()

  OffsetsTable = Global.getTable("OffsetsTable") 

  if self.memo ~= "0" then     
        self.createButton({
            label="S", click_function="DrawSite", function_owner=self,
            position={0, 0.1, 0.75}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=230, width=230,
            font_size=200, color={1,1,1}, font_color={0,0,0}
        })

        self.createButton({
            label="r", click_function="Return", function_owner=self,
            position={0.85, 0.1, -0.85}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=150, width=150,
            font_size=100, color=Color.fromString("Black"), font_color=Color.fromString("White")
        })      
  end

end

function Return()

    --draw replacement
    Tile = self.getGMNotes()
    Offsets = OffsetsTable[Tile]

    Bags = Global.getTable("WTokenBags")
    coBags = Global.getTable("coWTokenBags")
    if self.hasTag("MM") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["MBag"])
        coBag = coBags["MBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("CC") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["CBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["CBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("WW") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["WBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["WBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("PP") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["PBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["PBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("SS") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["SBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["SBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("DD") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["DBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["DBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("RR") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["RBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["RBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("TT") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["TBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["TBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("HH") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["HBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["HBag"]
    end

    if Bag ~= nil and Bag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then        
          local Token = Bag.takeObject()
          local Tag = string.sub(Token.getDescription(),1,1)
          if Tag == "G" or Tag == "S" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getDescription(),2,2))
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "i" or Tag == "t" or Tag == "m" or Tag == "+" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "s" or Tag == "x" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)            
          end

        --reset token
        self.setGMNotes("")  
        --Return to Bag
        self.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0,0,180))
        Wait.time( function()  self.setPositionSmooth({coBag[1],2,coBag[2]}) end,1)    

    end


end

--Draw Site
function DrawSite()

    Tile = self.getGMNotes()
    Offsets = OffsetsTable[Tile]
    
    SiteBag = getObjectFromGUID("ea2455")
    if SiteBag ~= nil and SiteBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then    
        --Site = SiteBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(math.random(2),0.25,math.random(2)), rotation = {0,180,0}})
        Token = SiteBag.takeObject()
        local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getGMNotes(),1,1))
        params = {
            tile = Tile,
            clearing = Clearing,
            rotation = 180,
            token = Token.guid,
            offsets = Offsets,
            lock = 0,
            height = 1,
        }
        Global.call("setupToken",params)

      self.clearButtons()
      self.memo = "0"
    end

end

  if self.locked or 1 == 1 then

        function()

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.

            local selfPos = self.getPosition()

            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},

function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)

        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table

        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {

--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,

    })

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end

        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}

end

    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)

    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })

ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

    Global.call("Abandon_Mission",self.guid)

end

function mission_discard()
    Global.call("Replace_Mission",self.guid)

    --"Complete" mission
    self.setGMNotes("0")
    self.clearButtons()

    --discard
    Global.call("card_discard",self.guid)
end

        player_color = player_color,
        steal = true,        
        dcount = xdcount,
        tcount = xtcount,
        icount = xicount,
        scount = xscount,
        famount = xfamount,
        gamount = xgamount,
        outlaw = xoutlaw,
        charisma = 0,
        wisdom = 0,
        intellect = 0,        
    }

    Global.call("Complete_Mission",params)

    }
