function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function onObjectHover(player_color)
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects(true)) do
        if obj.type == "Deck" then
            if obj.getQuantity() >= 5 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 4th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,3) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 5th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,4) end
                )            
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 4 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 4th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,3) end
                )            
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 3 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 2 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )               
            end                
        elseif obj.type == "Card" then
            obj.clearContextMenu()
            obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
              function () loot_card(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
            )        
        end
    end
end

Ordinal = {"st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th"}

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

function onObjectHover(player_color)
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects(true)) do
        if obj.type == "Deck" then
            if obj.getQuantity() >= 5 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 4th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,3) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 5th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,4) end
                )            
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 4 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 4th card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,3) end
                )            
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 3 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 3rd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,2) end
                )
            elseif obj.getQuantity() == 2 then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
                )
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot 2nd card",
                  function () loot_deck(player_color,obj.guid,1) end
                )               
            end                
        elseif obj.type == "Card" then
            obj.clearContextMenu()
            obj.addContextMenuItem("Loot top card",
              function () loot_card(player_color,obj.guid,0) end
            )        
        end
    end
end

Ordinal = {"st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th"}

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

function loot_deck(_player_color, _guid, _index)       
    if not (_player_color == "Green" or _player_color == "Red"
            or _player_color == "Blue" or _player_color == "Yellow"
            or _player_color == "Pink" or _player_color == "Purple")
    then
        broadcastToAll("Choose a suitable color before looting!",  Color(0.627, 0.125, 0.941))  
        return
    end       

    deck = getObjectFromGUID(_guid)    
    if deck then
        local card = deck.takeObject({
            index = _index
        })
        Wait.frames(function()
            card.deal(1, _player_color)
            broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))            
        end, 3)    
    end
end

function loot_card(_player_color, _guid, _index)
    card = getObjectFromGUID(_guid) 
    if card then
        card.deal(1, _player_color)
        broadcastToAll(Player[_player_color].steam_name .. " loots the " .. (_index + 1) .. Ordinal[_index + 1] .. " card.", Color.fromString(_player_color))  
    end
end

function buttonClick_W()
  if self.locked or 1 == 1 then
    	DBag = getObjectFromGUID("87ba87")    	
      if DBag ~= nil and DBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then
          --local Token = DBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0,0.25,0), rotation = {0,180,180}})
          local Token = DBag.takeObject()
          local Tag = string.sub(Token.getDescription(),1,1)
          if Tag == "G" or Tag == "S" then
            Token.setGMNotes(self.guid)
            local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getDescription(),2,2))
            params = {
                tile = self.guid,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "i" or Tag == "t" or Tag == "m" or Tag == "+" then
            Token.setGMNotes(self.guid)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = self.guid,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "s" or Tag == "x" then
            Token.setGMNotes(self.guid)
            params = {
                tile = self.guid,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)            
          end

          self.memo = "0"
          self.clearButtons()
          createSetupButtons() 
      end
    end

end

  setupM(0)
end

  setupM(180)
end
function setupM(rotation)

    --Grey Dice
    Grey1 = getObjectFromGUID("112c0a")
    Grey2 = getObjectFromGUID("08cd57")
    GType = Grey1.getValue()
    GNumber = Grey2.getValue()

    if GType == 5 then --Deserts
      local mBags = Global.getTable("bagsMonsters")
      GScorpionsBag =  getObjectFromGUID(mBags["GiantScorpions"])    
      if GScorpionsBag ~= nil and GScorpionsBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
        if GNumber < 4 then 
          GNumber = 1
        elseif GNumber < 6 then
          GNumber = 2
        else
          GNumber = 3
        end	                    	

        for i = 1, GNumber do
          if GScorpionsBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then
            Greyd6 = getObjectFromGUID("e5a9d0")   
            if Greyd6 ~= nil then
              local Token = GScorpionsBag.takeObject()
              local Clearing = Greyd6.getValue()
              params = {
                  tile = self.guid,
                  clearing = Clearing,
                  rotation = 0,
                  token = Token.guid,
                  offsets = Offsets,
                  lock = 0,
                  height = 2.15 + (0.1 * i),
              }
              Global.call("setupToken",params)
            else
              GScorpionsBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(-1,2.15 + (0.1 * i),-1), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 30, rotation)})
            end   
          end
        end

      end

    end   	
	

    --Black Dice
    Black1 = getObjectFromGUID("390778")
    Black2 = getObjectFromGUID("d8cef1")
    BType = Black1.getValue()
    BNumber = Black2.getValue()

    if BType == 4 then --Stench
      local mBags = Global.getTable("bagsMonsters")
      LamiasBag =  getObjectFromGUID(mBags["Lamias"])    
      if LamiasBag ~= nil and LamiasBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 

       if BNumber < 4 then 
         BNumber = 1
       elseif BNumber < 6 then
         BNumber = 2
       else
         BNumber = 3
       end
      
       for i = 1, BNumber do
          if LamiasBag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then
            LamiasBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(1,2.15 + (0.1 * i),-1), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 30, rotation)})
          end
       end

      end

    end 

end

    --draw replacement

    if self.hasTag("MM") then

        coBag = coBags["MBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("CC") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["CBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["CBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("WW") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["WBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["WBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("PP") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["PBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["PBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("SS") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["SBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["SBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("DD") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["DBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["DBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("RR") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["RBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["RBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("TT") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["TBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["TBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("HH") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["HBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["HBag"]
    end

    if Bag ~= nil and Bag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then        
          local Token = Bag.takeObject()
          local Tag = string.sub(Token.getDescription(),1,1)
          if Tag == "G" or Tag == "S" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getDescription(),2,2))
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)

            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "s" or Tag == "x" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)

        return
    end

    --print(self.getPosition()[1])
    --print(self.getPosition()[3])

       _loc = _merc.getGMNotes() 
    else
        return

    end

    --Missions deck
    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")    
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])

                break

                local obj = ideck.takeObject({ position = Vector(x, 2.5, y), rotation = Vector(0, 180, 180) })

        iCard.setDescription(_merc.getDescription())

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}

    self.createButton({

	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)

	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

        })     
  end

function Return()

    --draw replacement
    Tile = self.getGMNotes()
    Offsets = OffsetsTable[Tile]

    Bags = Global.getTable("WTokenBags")
    coBags = Global.getTable("coWTokenBags")
    if self.hasTag("MM") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["MBag"])
        coBag = coBags["MBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("CC") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["CBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["CBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("WW") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["WBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["WBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("PP") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["PBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["PBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("SS") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["SBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["SBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("DD") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["DBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["DBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("RR") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["RBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["RBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("TT") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["TBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["TBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("HH") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["HBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["HBag"]
    end

    if Bag ~= nil and Bag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then        
          local Token = Bag.takeObject()
          local Tag = string.sub(Token.getDescription(),1,1)
          if Tag == "G" or Tag == "S" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getDescription(),2,2))
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "i" or Tag == "t" or Tag == "m" or Tag == "+" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "s" or Tag == "x" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)            
          end
    
    
        --reset token
        self.setGMNotes("")  
        --Return to Bag
        self.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0,0,180))
        Wait.time( function()  self.setPositionSmooth({coBag[1],2,coBag[2]}) end,1)        
    
    end


end

--Draw Item
function draw_item()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        ItemsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        iCard = card
    end

    if ItemsDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if ItemsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = ItemsDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()                
            end
        end
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))                 
    end

    self.clearButtons()
    self.memo = "0"

end

    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function onLoad()

    OffsetsTable = Global.getTable("OffsetsTable") 

  if self.memo ~= "0" then

            position={0.85, 0.1, -0.85}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=150, width=150,
            font_size=100, color=Color.fromString("Black"), font_color=Color.fromString("White")
        })     
  end

end

function Return()

    --draw replacement
    Tile = self.getGMNotes()
    Offsets = OffsetsTable[Tile]

    Bags = Global.getTable("WTokenBags")
    coBags = Global.getTable("coWTokenBags")
    if self.hasTag("MM") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["MBag"])
        coBag = coBags["MBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("CC") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["CBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["CBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("WW") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["WBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["WBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("PP") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["PBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["PBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("SS") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["SBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["SBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("DD") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["DBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["DBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("RR") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["RBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["RBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("TT") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["TBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["TBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("HH") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["HBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["HBag"]
    end

    if Bag ~= nil and Bag.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then        
          local Token = Bag.takeObject()
          local Tag = string.sub(Token.getDescription(),1,1)
          if Tag == "G" or Tag == "S" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = tonumber(string.sub(Token.getDescription(),2,2))
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "i" or Tag == "t" or Tag == "m" or Tag == "+" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "s" or Tag == "x" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)            
          end
    
    
        --reset token
        self.setGMNotes("")  
        --Return to Bag
        self.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0,0,180))
        Wait.time( function()  self.setPositionSmooth({coBag[1],2,coBag[2]}) end,1)        
    
    end


end

--Draw Item
function draw_item()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        ItemsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        iCard = card
    end

    if ItemsDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if ItemsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = ItemsDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()                
            end
        end
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 1.6))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))                 
    end

    self.clearButtons()
    self.memo = "0"

end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()

ContainedObjects.Description: Contains 2 spells. When a libram is revealed, draw the indicated number of spell cards from the deck and place them face-down under the treasure card. These spells are available for a spell caster to learn if the hero has a magic cube matching the spell type. The treasure card is discarded if the last spell is removed from it, typically because a spell caster learned the spell.

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

        end

--The card Setup function to get card from a variable object (deckDeck), with a specific name (cardName). The (type) serve to specify the slot on the player board while (player_color) is self explanatory.            

function take_card(deckDeck , cardName, slotN, player_color, rota_value)
    local found = false
    local deckContents = deckDeck.getObjects()
    local player = player_color
    local slot = slotN
    local rv = rota_value
    
    slotsList = Global.getTable("itemCoordinates")

  
    for _, object in ipairs(deckContents) do
        if object.name == cardName then CardGuid=object.guid
            
         local  params = {
                position = (slotsList[player][slot]) ,
                rotation = {0, rv, 0} ,
                guid = CardGuid
            }

            deckDeck.takeObject(params)
            found = true
            break
        end
    end

    if found==false then broadcastToAll("Card not found") end
end

--The Cube Setup function to get a specific (amount) of a specific (color) of cubes. To not complicate the process too much the healt token are a considered a (color), healtToken. The (type) variables is used for setting up the cubes in ordinated line. Only four types exis, to accomodate the existing 4 row of snipping points.--

    function take_cube(type, color, amount, player_color, rota_value)
          
        count = amount
        supplyList = Global.getTable("supplyCubesGuid")
        cubeColor = color
        supply = getObjectFromGUID(supplyList[cubeColor])
        local player = player_color 
        cubesTable = Global.getTable("cubesCoordinates")
        cubesPos =  cubesTable[player][type]
        r = rota_value-180
        x= cubesPos[1]
        y= cubesPos[2]
        z= cubesPos[3]
        adj = get_offset(type, player_color)
   
    if player=="Blue" or player=="Yellow" or player == "Pink" then    
               x=x+adj
               for i=1, count do
               supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
               x=x+0.6
        end
    end        
    if player=="xxPink"  or player=="xxPurple" then
            z=z+adj
            for i=1, count do
            supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            z=z+0.6
        end     
    end        


     if player=="Red"  or player=="Green" or player =="Purple" then
            x=x-adj
            for i=1, count do
            supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            x=x-0.6  
        end       
    end   
end
