--[[
    The purpose of this script is to display a message in the chat of the results of the Summon die roll.
]]

is_checking_roll = false                -- Is used to determine if the die has "settled" (i.e. stopped rolling)

function onRandomize(player_color)
    if not is_checking_roll then
        -- The die is still rolling, so run the "SummonDieRoll" code
        is_checking_roll = true
        NativesDieRoll(player_color)
    end
end

function NativesDieRoll()
    Wait.condition(
        function()
            -- The die has stopped rolling, so broadcast the results and update the die
            is_checking_roll = false
            announceDieRollResults()
        end,
        function()
            return self.resting
        end
    )
end

function announceDieRollResults()
    local message_color = Color(1, 1, 1)

    local messages = {
        " No Natives appear",
        " Cunning Natives",
        " All Natives appear",
        " Wise Natives",
        " Charismatic Natives",
        " No Natives appear"
    }

    local message = messages[self.getValue()]
    self.setName(message)
    broadcastToAll(message, message_color)
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

    local howManyButtons = 0

            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x

            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({

    local deltaPos = {}

    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do

    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")

            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

    end

            end
        end
    elseif iCard then

        iCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))                 
    end

    self.memo = "0"

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

    --draw replacement
    Tile = self.getGMNotes()

    Bags = Global.getTable("WTokenBags")

        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["MBag"])
        coBag = coBags["MBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("CC") then
        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["CBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["CBag"]
    elseif self.hasTag("WW") then

        Bag = getObjectFromGUID(Bags["SBag"])    
        coBag = coBags["SBag"]

    end

                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)
          elseif Tag == "i" or Tag == "t" or Tag == "m" or Tag == "+" then
            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            local Clearing = math.random(6)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = Clearing,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)

            Token.setGMNotes(Tile)
            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = 1,
                rotation = 180,
                token = Token.guid,
                offsets = {{0, 0, 0}},
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)            
          end
    
    
        --reset token
        self.setGMNotes("")  
        --Return to Bag
        self.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0,0,180))
        Wait.time( function()  self.setPositionSmooth({coBag[1],2,coBag[2]}) end,1)        
    
    end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

    memoryList = {}

    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end

--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,

    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},

function setup_weather(season)
    SLabel = getObjectFromGUID("43ea4e") --Season Label
    if SLabel then
        SLabel.setValue(season)
        --SLabel.setFontColor(seasonColor[season])
    end

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["WZone"])
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then                
                local _contents = obj.getObjects(true) -- Returns list of card data
                for _, _card in ipairs(_contents) do                    
                    --_card.tags is a table of strings
                    local tagfound = false
                    if _card.tags and #_card.tags > 0 then
                        for _, tag in ipairs(_card.tags) do
                            if tag == season then
                                tagfound = true                                
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    --discard if no season tag found
                    if not tagfound then 
                        --discard
                        local  params = {
                                position = {65.5,2,64.5} ,
                                rotation = {0,-90,180},
                                guid = _card.guid
                            }
                        obj.takeObject(params)
                    end
                end

                --Shuffle deck
                Wait.time(function() obj.shuffle() end, 1)
            end 
        end
    end
end

function return_die(dieName, guid)        
    local coDice = Global.getTable("coDice")
    local coDie = coDice[dieName]

    local Die = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    local DieValue = Die.getValue()

    local DieRotation = {
        Vector(270,90,0),
        Vector(0,90,0),
        Vector(0,90,270),
        Vector(0,90,90),
        Vector(0,90,180),
        Vector(90,90,0),
    }    

    if Die ~= nil then
        Die.setRotationSmooth(DieRotation[DieValue])
        Die.setPositionSmooth({coDie[1],2,coDie[2]})
    end
end

function new_turn()
    --Weather
    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    WZone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["WZone"]) -- Weather deck Zone
    if WZone then
        -- get variables
        Wcount = tonumber(WZone.getGMNotes()) --game ends after nth card expires
        UWLabel = getObjectFromGUID("664277") -- Upcoming label
        TurnCounter = getObjectFromGUID("1fdfbc") --Turn Order counter
        TurnZone = getObjectFromGUID("27eead") --Turn Order Zone.
        WAZone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["WAZone"]) --Active Weather Zone
        Wduration = tonumber(WAZone.getGMNotes()) -- active weather card duration
        WUZone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["WUZone"]) --Upcoming Weather Zone
        Wupcoming = tonumber(WUZone.getGMNotes())  --countdown till drawing new upcoming card  

        --print("Wcount="..Wcount)
        --print("Wduration="..Wduration)
        --print("Wupcoming="..Wupcoming)

        --game end check        
        if Wcount == WTotal and Wduration == 0 and Wupcoming <= 0 then
            --discard active card
            local _acard = find_card(WAZone)
            if _acard then
                _acard.memo = "-1"
                --Global.call("card_discard",_acard.guid)
                --clear cubes
                for _,obj in ipairs(WAZone.getObjects(true)) do
                    if obj.type == "Block" then
                        obj.destruct()
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif Wcount == WTotal and Wduration == 2 and Wupcoming <= 0 then
            Wduration = 0
            WAZone.setGMNotes(Wduration)
            --store the last turn value here
            if UWLabel then
                local _turn = tonumber(TurnCounter.getGMNotes())
                TurnZone.setGMNotes(_turn + 1)
                UWLabel.setValue("Last Turn : "..TurnZone.getGMNotes())
            end      
            -- place last cube on last card
            local _card = find_card(WAZone)
            place_cube(_card)                  
        elseif Wcount == 0 then
            --draw new active card         
            local _card = get_card(WAZone, 1, "WZone")
            Wait.time(function() _card.setLock(true) end,2)
            _card.memo = "0"
            Wcount = 1
            WZone.setGMNotes(Wcount)
            -- set durations
            local _notes = tonumber(_card.getGMNotes())
            Wduration = math.floor(_notes / 10)
            WAZone.setGMNotes(Wduration)            
            Wupcoming = _notes % 10
            WUZone.setGMNotes(Wupcoming)
            
            -- place cube on new card
            Wait.time(function() place_cube(_card) end,2)

            --Weather effects
            Wait.time(function() enchant()  end,2)  

        elseif Wduration == 1 then  --duration check
            --discard active card
            local _acard = find_card(WAZone)
            if _acard then
                _acard.memo = "-1"                
                --Global.call("card_discard",_acard.guid)
            end
                --clear cubes
            for _,obj in ipairs(WAZone.getObjects(true)) do

                end
            end

            --if Wcount < WTotal then

                local _ucard = find_card(WUZone)
                if _ucard then

                end                                    
            --end

                WUZone.setGMNotes(Wupcoming)
            end     
        else

            --decrement upcoming
            --if Wupcoming > 0 then

            --end

function place_cube(_card)
    if _card then
        local _notes = tonumber(_card.getGMNotes())
        local _t = math.floor(_notes / 10)
        local t_array = weatherCubes["t".._t]
        local _i = tonumber(_card.memo)
        _i = _i + 1
        local i_array = t_array["i".._i]
        _supply = Global.getTable("supplyCubesGuid")
        _bag = getObjectFromGUID(_supply["pink"])
        if _bag then
            _bag.takeObject({ position = (_card.getPosition() + Vector(i_array[1], 0.15, i_array[2])),
                            rotation = (_card.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)) 
                            })
            --increment index
            _card.memo = _i            
        end
    end
end

function put_card(_card, _obj)
    if _card and _obj then
        _card.setPositionSmooth(_obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, 0))
        _card.setRotationSmooth(_obj.getRotation() + Vector(0, 180, 0))         
    end
end

function find_card(_zone)
    local card
    if _zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(_zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Card" then
                if obj.memo then
                    if obj.memo ~= "-1" then
                        card = obj
                        return card
                    end
                else
                    card = obj
                    return card
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function get_card(_obj, _count, _type)    
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones[_type])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        for i = 1, _count do            
            if deck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                card = deck.takeObject({ position = (_obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, 0)), rotation = (_obj.getRotation() + Vector(0, 180, 0)) })
                return card            
            end
        end
    elseif card then
        card.setPositionSmooth(_obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, 0))
        card.setRotationSmooth(_obj.getRotation() + Vector(0, 180, 0))        
        return card                
    end
end

function replenish_missions()

        _zone = getObjectFromGUID(MZones[i])

            --print("mzone:".._zone.getGMNotes())        
            if _merc and _merc.memo == "0" then
                --process zone contents
                local _mcount = 0
                local _total = 0
                for _, obj in ipairs(_zone.getObjects(true)) do
                    --print(obj.type)
                    if obj.type == "Tile" then
                        --get metadata
                        if obj.hasTag("side1") then
                            _total = tonumber(_zone.getName())

                        if obj.hasTag("side2") then
                            _total = tonumber(_zone.getDescription())

                end
            end
        end
    end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function setup_group()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["tZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        TreasuresDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        tCard = card
    end

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        ItemsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        iCard = card
    end

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local deck, card
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                deck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                card = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if deck then
        MissionsDeck = deck
    elseif card then
        mCard = card
    end

    if MissionsDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if MissionsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                obj = MissionsDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0), rotation = {180,90,0}})
                obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                obj.setGMNotes(self.getDescription())
            obj.addTag("Active")
            end
        end 
    elseif mCard then
        mCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0))
        mCard.setPositionSmooth({180,90,0})
        mCard.memo = self.getGMNotes()
        mCard.setGMNotes(self.getDescription())
        mCard.addTage("Active")
    end

    if ItemsDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if ItemsDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                Wait.time(function() obj = ItemsDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0), rotation = {180,90,0}})
                    --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                end,1)
            end
        end 
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth({180,90,0})        
    end

    if TreasuresDeck then
        for i = 1, 1 do
            if TreasuresDeck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
                Wait.time(function() obj = TreasuresDeck.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0), rotation = {180,90,0}})
                    --obj.memo = self.getGMNotes()
                end,2)
            end
        end
    elseif tCard then
        tCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0))
        tCard.setPositionSmooth({180,90,0})                 
    end

    --Wait.time( function() self.destruct() end,3) 
    self.memo = "0"
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButtons()

end

    if self.getGMNotes() == "" then

    end

    createSetupButtons()      
end    

function createSetupButtons()

    limit = 0

    -- local rot = self.getRotation()
    -- if rot[3] < math.abs(10) then --side 1

    -- else -- side 2
    --     limit = 0
    -- end

    local i = tonumber(self.getGMNotes())

        })          
    end  

end    

function get_pink()

    pinkBag = getObjectFromGUID("442af4")
    if pinkBag then
        pinkBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(1.3,1,1.1), rotation = self.getRotation()})
    end

    local i = tonumber(self.getGMNotes())   
    self.setGMNotes(tostring(tonumber(self.getGMNotes()) + 1))
    
    self.clearButtons()    
    createSetupButtons() 

end

function SetMeUp()
    rnd = math.random(2)

    if rnd == 2 then
        self.flip()

        self.clearButtons()
        createSetupButtons()         
    end    

    Wait.time(function() self.lock() end,2)
end

function onLoad()
    charisma = 0
    wisdom = 0
    intellect = 1
    dcount = 0
    tcount = 0
    icount = 0
    scount = 0
    famount = 0
    gamount = 0
    outlaw = 1
    xdcount = 0
    xtcount = 0
    xicount = 0
    xscount = 0
    xfamount = 0
    xgamount = 0
    xoutlaw = 0     

    --Inactive Mission
    if self.hasTag("Inactive") then
        self.clearButtons()
        return
    end

    --check for Civ Mission
    if self.hasTag("Active") and self.hasTag("CivTile") 
        and not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") then
        Global.call("check_civ_mission",self.guid) --will add Discard Tag   
    end    
    --per Native group : Discard if not Native Group terrain pack in play
    if self.hasTag("Active") and self.hasTag("Natives")    
        and not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") then

        Global.call("check_natives_terrain_mission",self.guid) -- will add Discard tag
    end
    --per Merchant and/or Natives Group : Replace if with same
    if self.hasTag("Active") and self.hasTag("Merchant") 
        and not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") then        

        Global.call("check_merchant_mission",self.guid) -- will add Replace Tag
    end

    createSetupButtons()
end

function createSetupButtons()
    if self.hasTag("Active") then
        if (not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and not self.hasTag("Steal"))
            or (self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and self.hasTag("CivTile") and not self.hasTag("Steal")) --Package exception
            or (self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and self.hasTag("Merchant") and not self.hasTag("Steal")) --Natives cant spawn 
            then
            self.createButton({
                label="Abandon", click_function="mission_abandon", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,-1.4}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.5,0.5,0.5}
            })
        end
        if not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") then 
            self.createButton({
                label="Complete", click_function="mission_complete", function_owner=self,
                position={-0.825, 0.3,-1.4}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=260,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            })
        end  
        if self.hasTag("Replace") then --replace
            self.createButton({
                label="Replace", click_function="mission_replace", function_owner=self,
                position={-0.825, 0.3,-1.4}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            })
        end
        if self.hasTag("Discard") then --discard
            self.createButton({
                label="Discard", click_function="mission_discard", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,-1.3}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            }) -- change z to -1.4 after testing
        end          
        if (not self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and self.hasTag("Steal"))
            or (self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and self.hasTag("CivTile") and self.hasTag("Steal")) --Package exception
            or (self.hasTag("Discard") and not self.hasTag("Replace") and self.hasTag("Merchant") and self.hasTag("Steal")) --Natives cant spawn
            then
            self.createButton({
                label="Discard", click_function="mission_steal", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,0.8}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.85,0,0}
            })
        end        
    end
end

function mission_abandon()
    Global.call("Abandon_Mission",self.guid)
end

function mission_replace()
    Global.call("Replace_Mission",self.guid)
    Wait.time(function() Global.call("Abandon_Mission",self.guid) end, 2)
end

function mission_discard()
    Global.call("Replace_Mission",self.guid)

    --"Complete" mission
    self.setGMNotes("0")
    self.clearButtons()

    --discard
    Global.call("card_discard",self.guid)
end

function mission_steal(obj, player_color)
    --spoils
    local params = {
        guid = self.guid,
        player_color = player_color,
        steal = true,        
        dcount = xdcount,
        tcount = xtcount,
        icount = xicount,
        scount = xscount,
        famount = xfamount,
        gamount = xgamount,
        outlaw = xoutlaw,
        charisma = 0,
        wisdom = 0,
        intellect = 0,        
    }

    Global.call("Complete_Mission",params)
end

function mission_complete(obj, player_color)
    --rewards
    local params = {
        guid = self.guid,
        player_color = player_color,
        steal = false,
        dcount = dcount,
        tcount = tcount,
        icount = icount,
        scount = scount,
        famount = famount,
        gamount = gamount,
        outlaw = outlaw,
        charisma = charisma,
        wisdom = wisdom,
        intellect = intellect,
    }

    Global.call("Complete_Mission",params)
end

function onLoad()

    Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")

    createSetupButtons()

end

function createSetupButtons()
    if self.getGMNotes()  ~= "0" then --not finished
        if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "Z", 1, true) == fail --not Z
            or string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "S", 1, true) ~= fail --has S            
            then
            self.createButton({
                label="Abandon", click_function="mission_abandon", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,-1.4}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.5,0.5,0.5}
            })
        end
        if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "Z", 1, true) == fail then --not Z    
            self.createButton({
                label="Complete", click_function="mission_complete", function_owner=self,
                position={-0.825, 0.3,-1.4}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=260,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            })
        end  
        if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "R", 1, true) ~= fail and string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "Z", 1, true) ~= fail then --replace
            self.createButton({
                label="Replace", click_function="mission_replace", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,-1}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            })
        end
        if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "D", 1, true) ~= fail and string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "Z", 1, true) ~= fail then --discard
            self.createButton({
                label="Discard", click_function="mission_discard", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,-1}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
            })
        end          
        if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "S", 1, true)  ~= fail then--steal
            self.createButton({
                label="Steal", click_function="mission_steal", function_owner=self,
                position={0.85, 0.3,0.8}, rotation={0,0,0}, height=50, width=240,
                font_size=50, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.85,0,0}
            })
        end        
    end
end

function mission_abandon()
    --clear fields
    self.memo = ""
    self.setDescription("")
    
    --return to deck
    local coBags = Global.getTable("coBagsMonsters")
    local coBag = coBags["missions"]

    self.setLock(false)
    self.setRotation({0,-90,180})
    self.setPositionSmooth({coBag[1],3,coBag[2]})

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local ideck, iCard
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                ideck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                iCard = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

   --shuffle
      if ideck ~= nil then
        Wait.time( function() ideck.shuffle() end,3)
      end

end

function mission_complete(obj, player_color)
    
    --Atrocity
    if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "X", 1, true)  ~= fail then -- atrocity
        local OutlawBag = getObjectFromGUID("a45343")
        OutlawBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)})  
    end
    --Attribute c:3d491b w:362d93 i:2a77c0
    if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "c", 1, true)  ~= fail then
        local cBag = getObjectFromGUID("3d491b")
        cBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)})         
    end
    if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "w", 1, true)  ~= fail then
        local wBag = getObjectFromGUID("362d93")
        wBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)})         
    end
    if string.find(self.getGMNotes(), "i", 1, true)  ~= fail then
        local iBag = getObjectFromGUID("2a77c0")
        iBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)})         
    end   

    --Complete
    self.setGMNotes("0")
    self.clearButtons()
    self.setDescription("Mission completed by "..Player[player_color].steam_name)
    broadcastToAll("Mission completed by "..Player[player_color].steam_name, Player[player_color].color)    

end

function mission_replace()

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local ideck, iCard
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                ideck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                iCard = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

    --draw new card    
    if  ideck then
        if ideck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
            local obj = ideck.takeObject({ position = (self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, -2)), rotation = (self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)) })
            obj.memo = self.memo
            obj.setGMNotes(self.getgetGMNotes())
        end   
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, -2))
        iCard.setGMNotes(self.getGMNotes())
    iCard.memo = self.memo
    end

    --abandon           
    Wait.time(function() mission_abandon() end, 2)        
   
end

function mission_discard()

    local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["mZone"])
    local ideck, iCard
    if zone then
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                ideck = obj
                break 
            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                iCard = obj
                break
            end
        end
    end

    --draw new card    
    if  ideck then
        if ideck.getData().ContainedObjects ~= nil then 
            local obj = ideck.takeObject({ position = (self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, -2)), rotation = (self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)) })
            obj.memo = self.memo
            obj.setGMNotes(self.getgetGMNotes())
        end   
    elseif iCard then
        iCard.setRotationSmooth(self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180))
        iCard.setPositionSmooth(self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.15, -2))
        iCard.setGMNotes(self.getGMNotes())
    iCard.memo = self.memo
    end

    --Complete
    self.setGMNotes("0")
    self.clearButtons()

    --discard
    Global.call("card_discard",self.guid)


 
end

function mission_steal(obj, player_color)    
    --Steal
    local OutlawBag = getObjectFromGUID("a45343")
    OutlawBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0, 0), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 0)})   

    --Complete
    self.setGMNotes("0")
    self.clearButtons()
    --createSetupButtons()
    self.setDescription("Mission stolen by "..Player[player_color].steam_name)
    broadcastToAll("Mission stolen by "..Player[player_color].steam_name, Player[player_color].color)    
end

    Tile = self.getGMNotes()
    Offsets = OffsetsTable[Tile]
            
    clearing = self.getDescription() 
    respot = false
    repeat
        rndCiv = math.random(6)  
        if rndCiv ~= tonumber(clearing) then
            self.setDescription(rndCiv)
        
            --redundant?
            maptile = getObjectFromGUID(self.getGMNotes())
            maptile.setGMNotes(rndCiv)  

            params = {
                tile = Tile,
                clearing = rndCiv,
                rotation = 180,
                token = self.guid,
                offsets = Offsets,
                lock = 0,
                height = 0.25,
            }
            Global.call("setupToken",params)

            broadcastToAll("Civilisation Location placed at clearing "..rndCiv,  Color(1, 0.5, 0))

            respot = true     
        end
    until respot
