function onObjectHover()
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects(true)) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            if obj.hasTag("Horse") then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Replace Horse",
                function () replace_horse(obj.guid) end
                )  
            elseif obj.hasTag("Item") then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Return Item",
                function () return_item(obj.guid) end
                )              
            end      
        end
    end
end

function return_item(guid)
    item = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if item then
        Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
        if zone then
            item.setRotationSmooth({0,270,180},false)     
            item.setPositionSmooth(zone.getPosition(),false)
            local deck
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" then
                    deck = obj
                    break 
                elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                    card = obj
                    break
                end
            end        
            if deck then 
                Wait.time( function() deck.shuffle() end, 2)
            end                     
        end
    end
end

function replace_horse(guid)    
    horse = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if horse then
        --locations = Global.getTable("playersRaceCoordinates")
        orientationList = Global.getTable("orientationValue")
        rr = orientationList[self.getGMNotes()]        
        Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])    
        --draw new item
        local deck, card
        if zone then
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" then
                    deck = obj
                    break 
                elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                    card = obj
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if deck then
            deck.takeObject{ position = horse.getPosition(), rotation = {0,rr,0}}
        elseif card then
            card.setPositionSmooth{horse.getPosition(), false}
        end                          

        --return horse        
        Wait.time( function() return_item(guid) end, 1)        
    end

end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end

            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x

function get_player_zones(player_color)
    -- get zone pair from global table
    zonesTable = Global.getTable("playerZones")
    zonesArray = zonesTable[player_color]
    zone1 = zonesArray[1]
    zone2 = zonesArray[2]
    zone3 = zonesArray[3]
    zone4 = zonesArray[4]
    zone5 = zonesArray[5]

    get_zone_cubes(zone3,player_color, false)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone1,player_color, false) end,1)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone2,player_color, false) end,2)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone4,player_color, false) end,3)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone5,player_color, true) end,4)
 
end

function get_zone_cubes(zone_guid, player_color, horse)
    zone = getObjectFromGUID(zone_guid)    
    -- get the cubes in a zone
    local cube
    if zone then
        -- h_offset = 0 --hearts
        -- a_offset = 0 --attack cubes
        -- s_offset = 0 --speed cubes
        -- m_offset = 0 --spell cubes        
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            --print(obj.type)
            if obj.hasTag("eoc") then                
                obj.destroy()
            elseif obj.type == "Block" then
                cube_guid = obj.guid
                local tags = obj.getTags()
                for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
                    -- call return_cube per cube, type is the cube tag
                    if tag == "Life" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, h_offset)
                        h_offset = h_offset + 1 
                    elseif tag == "Attack" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, a_offset)
                        a_offset = a_offset + 1                         
                    elseif tag == "Speed" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, s_offset)
                        s_offset = s_offset + 1
                    elseif tag == "Spell" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, m_offset)
                        m_offset = m_offset + 1
                    elseif tag == "Pink" and horse then --remove Horse wounds
                        obj.destruct()                        
                    end   
                    
                end                
            end
        end
    end
end

function return_cube(cube_guid, cube_type, player_color, i_offset)
             
    cube = getObjectFromGUID(cube_guid)
    count = 1
    --supplyList = Global.getTable("supplyCubesGuid")
    --cubeColor = color
    --supply = getObjectFromGUID(supplyList[cubeColor])
    --local player = player_color 

    --r = rota_value-180
    orientationList = Global.getTable("orientationValue")
    r = orientationList[player_color]  
    if cube_type == "Life" then
        r = r - 180
    end

    cubesTable = Global.getTable("cubesCoordinates")
    cubesPos =  cubesTable[player_color][cube_type]
    x = cubesPos[1]
    y = cubesPos[2]
    z = cubesPos[3]
    --adj = get_offset(cube_type, player_color)

    if player_color=="Blue" or player_color=="Yellow" or player_color=="Pink" then    
        --x = x + adj
        for i=1, count do
            --supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            x = x + (0.6 * i_offset)
            cube.setPositionSmooth({x, y, z})
            cube.setRotationSmooth({0, r, 0})                           
        end
    end            
    if player_color=="Red" or player_color=="Green" or player_color=="Purple" then
        --x = x - adj
        for i = 1, count do
            --supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            x = x - (0.6 * i_offset)            
            cube.setPositionSmooth({x, y, z})
            cube.setRotationSmooth({0, r, 0})                   

        end       
    end   
end    

function get_offset(cube_type, player_color)
    --local player = player_color
    cubesZoneList = Global.getTable("cubesScriptZones")
    zoneGuid = cubesZoneList[player_color]
    scriptZone = zoneGuid.getObjects()

    local offset = 0
    for _, object in ipairs(scriptZone) do
        local tags = object.getTags()
        for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
            if tag == cube_type then
                offset = offset + 0.6 
            end
        end
    end
    return  offset
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    --  self.createButton({
    --      label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
    --      position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
    --      font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    -- })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = -99,
    MAX_VALUE = 999,
    FONT_COLOR = {0,0,0,95},
    FONT_SIZE = 600,
    COLOR_HEX = "#000000",
    TOOLTIP_SHOW = true,
    VALUE = 0,
    CONTEXT_FIVE = true,
    CONTEXT_TEN = true,
    NUMBER_TYPED = true,
}
INJECTED_COUNTER = true


function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        CONFIG = loaded_data
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_FIVE then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+5", add_5, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-5", sub_5, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_TEN then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+10", add_10, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-10", sub_10, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.NUMBER_TYPED then
        self.max_typed_number = CONFIG.MAX_VALUE
    end
    createAll()
end

function onNumberTyped(player_color, number_typed)
    new_value = math.min(math.max(number_typed, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function add_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end
function add_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end

function sub_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end
function sub_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end

function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(CONFIG)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end
    local scale = {x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.5}
    local thickness = self.getBoundsNormalized().size.y
    if self.name == "Custom_Tile" then
        thickness = thickness*2
        scale = {0.75, 0.75, 0.75}
    end
    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0, thickness/2, 0},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 0,
      scale=scale,
      font_size=600,
      font_color=CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    self.createInput({
        value = self.getName(),
        input_function = "editName",
        tooltip=ttText,
        label = "",
        function_owner = self,
        alignment = 0,
        position = {0,thickness/2,1.7},
        width = 1200,
        height = 1000,
        font_size = 100,
        scale={x=1, y=1, z=1},
        font_color= CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
        color = {0,0,0,0}
        })

    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value)
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(CONFIG.VALUE + mod, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE)
        })
    setTooltips()
end

function setTooltips()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editInput({
        index = 0,
        value = self.getName(),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

    The purpose of this script is to display a message in the chat of the results of the d6 die roll.
]]

is_checking_roll = false                -- Is used to determine if the die has "settled" (i.e. stopped rolling)

function onRandomize(player_color)
    if not is_checking_roll then
        -- The die is still rolling, so run the "d6DieRoll" code
        is_checking_roll = true
        d6DieRoll(player_color)
    end
end

function d6DieRoll(player_color)
    Wait.condition(
        function()
            -- The die has stopped rolling, so broadcast the results and update the die
            is_checking_roll = false
            announceDieRollResults(player_color)
        end,
        function()
            return self.resting
        end
    )
end

function announceDieRollResults(player_color)
    local message_color = Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.85)

    local messages = {
        " fails to learn",
        " gets Cursed! (see Cursed card)",
        " fails to learn",
        " learns a spell",
        " learns a spell",
        " learns a spell"
    }

    local message = messages[self.getValue()]
    self.setName(message)
    broadcastToAll("[D8BFD8] " .. Player[player_color].steam_name .. message, message_color)
end

CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = -99,
    MAX_VALUE = 999,
    FONT_COLOR = {0,0,0,95},
    FONT_SIZE = 600,
    COLOR_HEX = "#000000",
    TOOLTIP_SHOW = true,
    VALUE = 0,
    CONTEXT_FIVE = true,
    CONTEXT_TEN = true,
    NUMBER_TYPED = true,
}
INJECTED_COUNTER = true


function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        CONFIG = loaded_data
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_FIVE then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+5", add_5, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-5", sub_5, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_TEN then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+10", add_10, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-10", sub_10, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.NUMBER_TYPED then
        self.max_typed_number = CONFIG.MAX_VALUE
    end
    createAll()
end

function onNumberTyped(player_color, number_typed)
    new_value = math.min(math.max(number_typed, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function add_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end
function add_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end

function sub_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end
function sub_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end

function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(CONFIG)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end
    local scale = {x=1.5, y=1.5, z=1.5}
    local thickness = self.getBoundsNormalized().size.y
    if self.name == "Custom_Tile" then
        thickness = thickness*2
        scale = {0.75, 0.75, 0.75}
    end
    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0, thickness/2, 0},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 0,
      scale=scale,
      font_size=600,
      font_color=CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    self.createInput({
        value = self.getName(),
        input_function = "editName",
        tooltip=ttText,
        label = "",
        function_owner = self,
        alignment = 0,
        position = {0,thickness/2,1.7},
        width = 1200,
        height = 1000,
        font_size = 100,
        scale={x=1, y=1, z=1},
        font_color= CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
        color = {0,0,0,0}
        })

    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value)
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(CONFIG.VALUE + mod, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE)
        })
    setTooltips()
end

function setTooltips()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editInput({
        index = 0,
        value = self.getName(),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function onLoad()
    createSetupButtons()
    --self.memo = nil

    LPTally = 0
end

function createSetupButtons()
    if self.memo ~= "0" then
        self.createButton({
            label="Outlaw", click_function="get_token", function_owner=self,
            position={-1.9, -0.3, -1.4}, rotation={0,0,180}, height=100, width=400,
            font_size=100, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,0,0}
        })
        self.createButton({
            label="Retire", click_function="retire", function_owner=self,
            position={-1.9, -0.3, 0.5}, rotation={0,0,180}, height=100, width=400,
            font_size=100, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,0,0}
        })    
    else
        self.createButton({
            label=self.getDescription(), click_function="do_nothing", function_owner=self,
            position={-2, -0.3, 0.5}, rotation={0,0,180}, height=0, width=0,
            font_size=100, color={0,0,0}, font_color={0.8,0,0}
        })        
    end
end

function do_nothing()
    --nothing
end

function get_token()
    local _flipped = false
    Zones = Global.getTable("outlawZones")
    _zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones[self.getGMNotes()])

    if _zone then
        for _,obj in ipairs(_zone.getObjects()) do            
            if obj.getGMNotes() == "outlaw" then
                if obj.getRotation()[3] < 2 and obj.getRotation()[3] > -2  then
                    --flip a token
                    _flipped = true
                    obj.flip()
                    break
                end
            end
        end        
    end
    
    --no flip get new token
    if not _flipped then
        local OutlawBag = getObjectFromGUID("a45343")
        location = Global.getTable("playersRaceCoordinates")   
        OutlawBag.takeObject({position = self.getPosition() + Vector(2.5, 1.5, 0.8), rotation = self.getRotation() + Vector(0, 0, 180)})     
    end
end

function retire()
    Zones = Global.getTable("outlawZones")
    _zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones[self.getGMNotes()])

    if _zone then
        local _count = 0
        for _,obj in ipairs(_zone.getObjects()) do            
            if obj.getGMNotes() == "outlaw" then
                if obj.getRotation()[3] > 179 then
                    _count = _count + 2 
                else
                    _count = _count + 1 
                end
            end
        end

        --print("count:".._count)
        for i = 1, _count do
            local die1 = 0
            local die2 = 0
            local IsRed1 = false
            local IsRed2 = false
            die1 = math.random(6) --print("d1:"..die1)
            if die1 > 4 then IsRed1 = true end
            die2 = math.random(6) --print("d2:"..die2)
            if die2 > 4 then IsRed2 = true end
            if IsRed1 and IsRed2 then 
                LPTally = LPTally + 1 print("Outlaw "..i.." : +1 LP")                
            elseif IsRed1 or IsRed2 then 
                LPTally = LPTally - 1 print("Outlaw "..i.." : -1 LP")
            else
                print("Outlaw "..i.." : No effect")
            end
        end
                
        self.setDescription("Outlaw LP tally: "..LPTally)

        --Clear Turn Order Bag
        local _turn = getObjectFromGUID("01a8cf")
        if 1 == 2 and _turn then
            _turn.setGMNotes("")
            _turn.clearButtons()
            _turn.Call("createTurnButtons")
        else
            --print("Turn bag not found")
        end

        self.memo = "0"
        self.clearButtons()
        createSetupButtons()
    end

end

function onObjectHover()
    for _, obj in ipairs(self.getObjects(true)) do
        if obj.type == "Card" then
            if obj.hasTag("Horse") then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Replace Horse",
                function () replace_horse(obj.guid) end
                )  
            elseif obj.hasTag("Item") then
                obj.clearContextMenu()
                obj.addContextMenuItem("Return Item",
                function () return_item(obj.guid) end
                )              
            end      
        end
    end
end

function return_item(guid)
    item = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if item then
        Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])
        if zone then
            item.setRotationSmooth({0,270,180},false)     
            item.setPositionSmooth(zone.getPosition(),false)
            local deck
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" then
                    deck = obj
                    break 
                elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                    card = obj
                    break
                end
            end        
            if deck then 
                Wait.time( function() deck.shuffle() end, 2)
            end                     
        end
    end
end

function replace_horse(guid)    
    horse = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if horse then
        --locations = Global.getTable("playersRaceCoordinates")
        orientationList = Global.getTable("orientationValue")
        rr = orientationList[self.getGMNotes()]        
        Zones = Global.getTable("deckZones")
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones["iZone"])    
        --draw new item
        local deck, card
        if zone then
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
                if obj.type == "Deck" then
                    deck = obj
                    break 
                elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                    card = obj
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if deck then
            deck.takeObject{ position = horse.getPosition(), rotation = {0,rr,0}}
        elseif card then
            card.setPositionSmooth{horse.getPosition(), false}
        end                          

        --return horse        
        Wait.time( function() return_item(guid) end, 1)        
    end

end

CONFIG = {
    MIN_VALUE = -99,
    MAX_VALUE = 999,
    FONT_COLOR = {0,0,0,95},
    FONT_SIZE = 600,
    COLOR_HEX = "#000000",
    TOOLTIP_SHOW = true,
    VALUE = 0,
    CONTEXT_FIVE = true,
    CONTEXT_TEN = true,
    NUMBER_TYPED = true,
}
INJECTED_COUNTER = true


function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        CONFIG = loaded_data
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_FIVE then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+5", add_5, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-5", sub_5, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.CONTEXT_TEN then
        self.addContextMenuItem("+10", add_10, true)
        self.addContextMenuItem("-10", sub_10, true)
    end
    if CONFIG.NUMBER_TYPED then
        self.max_typed_number = CONFIG.MAX_VALUE
    end
    createAll()
end

function onNumberTyped(player_color, number_typed)
    new_value = math.min(math.max(number_typed, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function add_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end
function add_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, false)
    end
end

function sub_5()
    for x=1, 5 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end
function sub_10()
    for x=1, 10 do
        add_subtract(nil, nil, true)
    end
end

function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(CONFIG)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end
    local scale = {x=0, y=0, z=0}
    local thickness = self.getBoundsNormalized().size.y
    if self.name == "Custom_Tile" then
        thickness = thickness*2
        scale = {0.75, 0.75, 0.75}
    end
    self.createButton({
      label=tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
      click_function="add_subtract",
      tooltip=ttText,
      function_owner=self,
      position={0, thickness/2, 0},
      height=600,
      width=1000,
      alignment = 0,
      scale=scale,
      font_size=600,
      font_color=CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
      color={0,0,0,0}
      })

    self.createInput({
        value = self.getName(),
        input_function = "editName",
        tooltip=ttText,
        label = "",
        function_owner = self,
        alignment = 0,
        position = {0,thickness/2,1.7},
        width = 1200,
        height = 1000,
        font_size = 100,
        scale={x=1, y=1, z=1},
        font_color= CONFIG.FONT_COLOR,
        color = {0,0,0,0}
        })

    setTooltips()
end

function editName(_obj, _string, value)
    self.setName(value)
    setTooltips()
end

function add_subtract(_obj, _color, alt_click)
    mod = alt_click and -1 or 1
    new_value = math.min(math.max(CONFIG.VALUE + mod, CONFIG.MIN_VALUE), CONFIG.MAX_VALUE)
    if CONFIG.VALUE ~= new_value then
        CONFIG.VALUE = new_value
        updateVal()
        updateSave()
    end
end

function updateVal()
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        label = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE)
        })
    setTooltips()
end

function setTooltips()
    if CONFIG.TOOLTIP_SHOW then
        ttText = self.getName().. ": " .. CONFIG.VALUE
    else
        ttText = self.getName()
    end

    self.editInput({
        index = 0,
        value = self.getName(),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
    self.editButton({
        index = 0,
        value = tostring(CONFIG.VALUE),
        tooltip = ttText
        })
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    -- self.createButton({
    --     label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
    --     position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
    --     font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    -- })

end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

if player=="Blue" or player=="Yellow" or player == "Pink" then

         for i=1, count do
         supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
         x=x+0.55
  end

      z=z+adj
      for i=1, count do
      supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
      z=z+0.55
  end     
end        


if player=="Red"  or player=="Green" or player =="Purple" then
      x=x-adj
      for i=1, count do
      supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
      x=x-0.55  
  end       
end   
end    


function get_offset(type, player_color)

    local player = player_color
          cubesZoneList = Global.getTable("cubesScriptZones")
          zoneGuid = getObjectFromGUID(cubesZoneList[player])
          scriptZone = zoneGuid.getObjects()

    local offset = 0
    for _, object in ipairs(scriptZone) do
        local tags = object.getTags()
        for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
            if tag == type then
                offset = offset + 0.55
              
                
            end
        end
    end
    return  offset
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    -- self.createButton({
    --     label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
    --     position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
    --     font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    -- })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function start_combat()
    self.setGMNotes(tonumber(self.getGMNotes() + 1))

end

function flip_tokens()
    Zones = Global.getTable("battleZones")
    battleZone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones[self.getDescription()])
    if battleZone ~= nil then
        --flip_tokens
        Tokens = battleZone.getObjects()
        for _, object in ipairs(Tokens) do

    local message_color = Color(1,1,1)
    broadcastToAll("A new round of combat begins.", message_color)

    --Increment Rot
    Zones = Global.getTable("battleZones")
    battleZone = getObjectFromGUID(Zones[self.getDescription()])
    if battleZone ~= nil then
        Tokens = battleZone.getObjects()
        for _, obj in ipairs(Tokens) do

function get_player_zones(player_color)
    -- get zone pair from global table
    zonesTable = Global.getTable("playerZones")
    zonesArray = zonesTable[player_color]
    zone1 = zonesArray[1]
    zone2 = zonesArray[2]
    zone3 = zonesArray[3]
    zone4 = zonesArray[4]
    zone5 = zonesArray[5]

    get_zone_cubes(zone3,player_color, false)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone1,player_color, false) end,1)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone2,player_color, false) end,2)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone4,player_color, false) end,3)
    Wait.time(function() get_zone_cubes(zone5,player_color, true) end,4)
 
end

function get_zone_cubes(zone_guid, player_color, horse)
    zone = getObjectFromGUID(zone_guid)    
    -- get the cubes in a zone
    local cube
    if zone then
        -- h_offset = 0 --hearts
        -- a_offset = 0 --attack cubes
        -- s_offset = 0 --speed cubes
        -- m_offset = 0 --spell cubes        
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects(true)) do
            --print(obj.type)
            if obj.hasTag("eoc") then                
                obj.destroy()
            elseif obj.type == "Block" then
                cube_guid = obj.guid
                local tags = obj.getTags()
                for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
                    -- call return_cube per cube, type is the cube tag
                    if tag == "Life" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, h_offset)
                        h_offset = h_offset + 1 
                    elseif tag == "Attack" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, a_offset)
                        a_offset = a_offset + 1                         
                    elseif tag == "Speed" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, s_offset)
                        s_offset = s_offset + 1
                    elseif tag == "Spell" then
                        return_cube(cube_guid, tag, player_color, m_offset)
                        m_offset = m_offset + 1
                    elseif tag == "Pink" and horse then --remove Horse wounds
                        obj.destruct()                        
                    end   
                    
                end                
            end
        end
    end
end

function return_cube(cube_guid, cube_type, player_color, i_offset)
             
    cube = getObjectFromGUID(cube_guid)
    count = 1
    --supplyList = Global.getTable("supplyCubesGuid")
    --cubeColor = color
    --supply = getObjectFromGUID(supplyList[cubeColor])
    --local player = player_color 

    --r = rota_value-180
    orientationList = Global.getTable("orientationValue")
    r = orientationList[player_color]  
    if cube_type == "Life" then
        r = r - 180
    end

    cubesTable = Global.getTable("cubesCoordinates")
    cubesPos =  cubesTable[player_color][cube_type]
    x = cubesPos[1]
    y = cubesPos[2]
    z = cubesPos[3]
    --adj = get_offset(cube_type, player_color)

    if player_color=="Blue" or player_color=="Yellow" or player_color=="Pink" then    
        --x = x + adj
        for i=1, count do
            --supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            x = x + (0.6 * i_offset)
            cube.setPositionSmooth({x, y, z})
            cube.setRotationSmooth({0, r, 0})                           
        end
    end            
    if player_color=="Red" or player_color=="Green" or player_color=="Purple" then
        --x = x - adj
        for i = 1, count do
            --supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
            x = x - (0.6 * i_offset)            
            cube.setPositionSmooth({x, y, z})
            cube.setRotationSmooth({0, r, 0})                   

        end       
    end   
end    

function get_offset(cube_type, player_color)
    --local player = player_color
    cubesZoneList = Global.getTable("cubesScriptZones")
    zoneGuid = cubesZoneList[player_color]
    scriptZone = zoneGuid.getObjects()

    local offset = 0
    for _, object in ipairs(scriptZone) do
        local tags = object.getTags()
        for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
            if tag == cube_type then
                offset = offset + 0.6 
            end
        end
    end
    return  offset
end

function updateSave()
    local data_to_save = {["ml"]=memoryList}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        --Set up information off of loaded_data
        memoryList = loaded_data.ml
    else
        --Set up information for if there is no saved saved data
        memoryList = {}
    end

    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
end


--Beginning Setup


--Make setup button
function createSetupButton()
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Triggered by setup button,
function buttonClick_setup()
    memoryListBackup = duplicateTable(memoryList)
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    createSetupActionButtons()
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            globalScaleFactor = 1.25 * 1/self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=1000, width=1000,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Creates submit and cancel buttons
function createSetupActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Cancel", click_function="buttonClick_cancel", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Submit", click_function="buttonClick_submit", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=1100,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Reset", click_function="buttonClick_reset", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end


--During Setup


--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Cancels selection process
function buttonClick_cancel()
    memoryList = memoryListBackup
    self.clearButtons()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        createSetupButton()
    else
        createMemoryActionButtons()
    end
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Selection Canceled", {1,1,1})
end

--Saves selections
function buttonClick_submit()
    if next(memoryList) == nil then
        broadcastToAll("You cannot submit without any selections.", {0.75, 0.25, 0.25})
    else
        self.clearButtons()
        createMemoryActionButtons()
        local count = 0
        for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
            count = count + 1
            local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
            if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
        end
        broadcastToAll(count.." Objects Saved", {1,1,1})
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Resets bag to starting status
function buttonClick_reset()
    memoryList = {}
    self.clearButtons()
    createSetupButton()
    removeAllHighlights()
    broadcastToAll("Tool Reset", {1,1,1})
    updateSave()
end


--After Setup


--Creates recall and place buttons
function createMemoryActionButtons()
    self.createButton({
        label="Place", click_function="buttonClick_place", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Recall", click_function="buttonClick_recall", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0.3,-2.8}, rotation={0,180,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    self.createButton({
        label="Setup", click_function="buttonClick_setup", function_owner=self,
        position={-2,0.3,0}, rotation={0,270,0}, height=350, width=800,
        font_size=250, color={0,0,0}, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
end

--Sends objects from bag/table to their saved position/rotation
function buttonClick_place()
    local bagObjList = self.getObjects()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        --If obj is out on the table, move it to the saved pos/rot
        if obj ~= nil then
            obj.setPositionSmooth(entry.pos)
            obj.setRotationSmooth(entry.rot)
            obj.setLock(entry.lock)
        else
            --If obj is inside of the bag
            for _, bagObj in ipairs(bagObjList) do
                if bagObj.guid == guid then
                    local item = self.takeObject({
                        guid=guid, position=entry.pos, rotation=entry.rot,
                    })
                    item.setLock(entry.lock)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ----broadcastToAll("Objects Placed", {1,1,1})
end

--Recalls objects to bag from table
function buttonClick_recall()
    for guid, entry in pairs(memoryList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then self.putObject(obj) end
    end
    --broadcastToAll("Objects Recalled", {1,1,1})
end


--Utility functions


--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Coroutine delay, in seconds
function wait(time)
    local start = os.time()
    repeat coroutine.yield(0) until os.time() > start + time
end

--Duplicates a table (needed to prevent it making reference to the same objects)
function duplicateTable(oldTable)
    local newTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(oldTable) do
        newTable[k] = v
    end
    return newTable
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--The Cube Setup function to get a specific (amount) of a specific (color) of cubes. To not complicate the process too much the healt token are a considered a (color), healtToken. The (type) variables is used for setting up the cubes in ordinated line. Only four types exis, to accomodate the existing 4 row of snipping points.--

function take_cube_race(type, color, amount, player_color, rota_value)

    count = amount
    supplyList = Global.getTable("supplyCubesGuid")
    cubeColor = color
    supply = getObjectFromGUID(supplyList[cubeColor])
    local player = player_color
    cubesTable = Global.getTable("cubesCoordinates")
    cubesPos =  cubesTable[player][type]
    r = rota_value-180
    x= cubesPos[1]
    y= cubesPos[2]
    z= cubesPos[3]
    adj = get_offset(type, player_color)

if player=="Blue" or player=="Yellow" or player == "Pink" then
         x=x+adj
         for i=1, count do
         supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
         x=x+0.6
  end
end
if player=="xxPink"  or player=="xxPurple" then
      z=z+adj
      for i=1, count do
      supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
      z=z+0.6
  end
end


if player=="Red"  or player=="Green" or player =="Purple" then
      x=x-adj
      for i=1, count do
      supply.takeObject({position = {x, y, z}, rotation = {0, r, 0}})
      x=x-0.6
  end
end
end


function get_offset(type, player_color)

    local player = player_color
          cubesZoneList = Global.getTable("cubesScriptZones")
          zoneGuid = getObjectFromGUID(cubesZoneList[player])
          scriptZone = zoneGuid.getObjects()

    local offset = 0
    for _, object in ipairs(scriptZone) do
        local tags = object.getTags()
        for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
            if tag == type then
                offset = offset + 0.6


            end
        end
    end
    return  offset
end

function bag_setup(player_color)

    bagsList = Global.getTable("playerBagsGuid")
    bag = bagsList[player_color]
    bag.call("buttonClick_place")
    cBags = Global.getTable("playerBattleBags")
    cBag = getObjectFromGUID(cBags[player_color])
    cBag.call("buttonClick_place")
    rBags = Global.getTable("playerRollBags")
    rBag = getObjectFromGUID(rBags[player_color])
    rBag.call("buttonClick_place")
end
